verdicts.reason: Both share the same structural flaws. The sun logo mark is squashed. There is a large dead gap between the headline and the body copy. The orange divider has moved from under the headline to between the body and the CTA, which breaks the original grouping. The legal line is unreadably small. A keeps the headline, body and CTA at stronger sizes, so the hierarchy holds up better at this size, though its body copy runs close to the side edges. B shrinks the eyebrow, body, CTA and 'Ships late June' text too far, which leaves the column feeling weak and the empty gaps even larger.
